description: This file contains functions and types for handling Microsoft Teams message attachments, including building message URLs, fetching and downloading media, and processing attachments and hosted content.

methods.name: readNestedString
methods.description: Reads a nested string value from an object given a list of keys.

methods.name: buildMSTeamsGraphMessageUrls
methods.description: Constructs message URLs for Microsoft Teams messages based on provided parameters.

methods.name: fetchGraphCollection
methods.description: Fetches a collection of items from Microsoft Graph API with SSRF protection.

methods.name: normalizeGraphAttachment
methods.description: Normalizes a Graph attachment object into a standard format.

methods.name: downloadGraphHostedContent
methods.description: Downloads all hosted content (images, files) from a Teams message.

methods.name: downloadMSTeamsGraphMedia
methods.description: Main function to download media from a Teams message, including attachments, hosted content, and SharePoint files.
